decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is distant from the maritime core and has shown no reported results, so it likely falls short of aspirations. The firm is growing and has slack, and the service reuses its existing recruitment infrastructure, so management will probably carry it a little longer rather than divert resources now.
Superyacht crew recruitment draws directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer pool at low extra cost, so it likely meets aspirations and there is little reason to drop it.
The Smart Academy reached six partner institutions within months of its April 2024 launch, which beats early expectations and fits the firm's core training and crewing business.
FuelEU monitoring is regulatory work clients cannot avoid, and the firm submitted all monitoring plans before the deadline, so the service meets aspirations and secures client relationships.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the PAL ship management software and supports the firm's digital and environmental direction, so it costs little to keep and supports the compliance services.
The cost simulator is part of the same integrated FuelEU package and adds value for clients as compliance costs take effect, so the firm keeps it despite results still being uncertain.
